# PiTTy v0.6.7 — request timing and reliable native screenshots

## Request timing

- Added a separate Timing sidebar section for settled request duration, model-to-first-tool latency, individual tool durations, and unioned wall time for parallel tools.
- Added bounded session-local medians for the active provider/model without changing the existing model-performance metrics.

## Native screenshot harness

- Hardened Kitty/X11 captures with exact empty-prompt validation, passive tmux-pane input isolation, safe focus handling, final recapture, and UID-scoped cleanup.

## Verification

- Typecheck, browser-conditioned tests, native screenshot generation, LSP diagnostics, and `git diff --check` passed.
